entities.summary: Mridula Garg is an Indian writer who writes in Hindi and English. She has published over 30 books in Hindi – novels, short story collections, plays and collections of essays – including several translated into English. She is a recipient of the Sahitya Akademi Award. Mridula Garg was a authors & novelists from Kolkata (b. 1938-10-25, Kolkata). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
